# Another Window Management (AWM)

> Another Window Management is a menu bar app for macOS 13 or later. It saves and restores window layouts across displays and positions windows with configurable keyboard shortcuts.

## What it does

- Save a named workspace with selected apps and windows, then restore it from the menu bar or a shortcut.
- Move, resize, center, and fill windows. Configure sizing cycles and window gaps in points or as a percentage.
- Associate workspaces with display arrangements and optionally restore them when connected displays change.
- Back up layouts, shortcuts, and preferences by copying the local `~/.awm.yaml` file.

## Explore AWM

- [Features](https://awm.mihaliak.com/#features): Saved workspaces, window shortcuts, multiple displays, and local backups.
- [Interactive demos](https://awm.mihaliak.com/#workspace-demo): Compare window layouts and see what the shortcuts do.
- [Setup guide](https://awm.mihaliak.com/#setup): Installation steps and macOS window control permission.
